label: sk-create-goal has one add candidate: SCG-005 seeds an undecided decision as a template placeholder, fails the goal check and stops the handoff, so a second turn that supplies the decision and checks the goal passes covers the completion path no scenario exercises (Q2). The other eight scenarios stay single prompt under Q4.

sk-create-quality-control has no conversation candidate: its six scenarios run a report-only audit, structure validation, batch snapshot, an authorized optimization or an evidence refusal, each one prompt plus script evidence; Q2 finds no second exchange and Q4 (or Q1 for the HVR judgment) keeps them single prompt.

sk-create-readme has no conversation candidate: its four scenarios are README routing, a skip decision and two evidence-first authoring checks, each one prompt plus local evidence; Q2 does not apply and Q4 (or Q1 for the skip judgment) keeps them single prompt.

sk-create-repo-rule has one add candidate: RRD-004's restraint refusal explicitly invites the user to name a present-day failure, and its triage says a later concrete failure makes the proposal re-testable, so a second turn that names the failure and checks the rule is authored covers the documented follow-up (Q2). The other fourteen scenarios stay single prompt under Q4.

sk-create-skill has no conversation candidate: its eleven scenarios scaffold a standalone skill or build a parent hub and check metadata, registry/router parity, the ready boundary and the format report; each is one prompt plus generated-file evidence, so Q2 does not apply and Q4 keeps them single prompt.

sk-create-with-human-voice has no conversation candidate: its nine scenarios run the mechanical scanner, the scope gate and a re-scan, and the judgment pass is a reader's one-prompt review; Q1 governs the judged reads and Q4 the scanner runs, so none needs a second exchange.
